title: Central Excise Update: Nil Rate of Duty for Petrol Exports Effective August 15, 2026
content:
# Central Excise Update: Nil Rate of Duty for Petrol Exports Effective August 15, 2026

Ek important update hai Central Excise ke stakeholders ke liye! Government ne Special Additional Excise Duty (SAED) on petrol exports ke liye 'Nil' rate announce kiya hai.

*   **Notification Number:** Central Excise Notification No. 43/2026.
*   **Notification Date:** 14th August 2026. (Though published on August 17, 2026, the notification itself is dated August 14, 2026).
*   **Effective From:** 15th August 2026.
*   **What Changed:** This notification amends the principal Notification No. 06/2026-Central Excise, dated 26th March 2026.
*   **Specific Impact:** Previously, a Special Additional Excise Duty (SAED) of Rs. 3.50 per litre was applicable on petrol (motor spirit) exported outside India, which was effective from August 3, 2026. Now, this duty rate has been substituted with 'Nil' for serial number 1 in the relevant table.
*   **Why:** This change has been made by the Central Government in the public interest.
